goal.description: Select the smallest admissible combination of IVP method, solve backend, source-specific transform and execution lane that minimizes predicted complete remaining-IVP cost while satisfying original source, stability, output, global-error and resource contracts.
goal.meaning_of_optimal: best among currently admitted candidates under observed evidence and remaining budget; no clairvoyant global optimality or regret guarantee

active_choice.combination_rule: sparse whitelist of mathematically compatible tuples; never unconstrained Cartesian product
active_choice.simultaneous_policy: one committed IVP method; one backend per active stage/solve; zero or small explicitly admitted transform set; unused probes/features remain off

decision_levels.purpose: read-only capability and permission filter before user callbacks

decision_levels.constraint: distinct equations/tableau/history/startup/estimator; method switching is not backend substitution

decision_levels.purpose: choose backend preserving selected method equations
decision_levels.constraint: same original W/target residual; do not alter method tableau
zero or few workers; original-equation back-map and error certificate required
no stage parallel claim from SIMD/ensemble/operator parallelism

observation_tiers.name: conditional_probe
observation_tiers.trigger: uncertainty, measured deterioration/relaxation, or regime change
observation_tiers.callbacks: only with permission and replay-safe declaration

observation_tiers.name: rare_expensive_analysis
observation_tiers.trigger: declared source family and repeat-use amortization

cost.mixing_rule: never mix units without calibrated mapping
cost.short_horizon_rule: do not switch if expected residence horizon cannot amortize setup/startup/history transfer

accuracy.rule: equal rtol or matching local embedded error does not imply equal achieved global error
accuracy.admissibility: certified original-target error bound when available; otherwise explicitly scoped calibrated error evidence and no global guarantee claim
accuracy.same_checkpoint_probe: same accepted (t_n,y_n), same source/output semantics and same target endpoint; probe never mutates committed trajectory; all work charged

switching.history: exact transfer if proved; otherwise valid new-method startup from accepted state and charge lost history
switching.recoverable_failure: discard candidate state, keep last accepted state, charge work, use protected fallback
switching.fatal_callback: stop; do not retry in another route
switching.cache: reuse only if method, step ratio, provider, source/model epoch, norm and workspace identities still match
switching.emergency_override: residual/nonfinite/domain/certificate/stability failure goes immediately to safe fallback or STOP

current_implementation.automaticOde: opt-in DOPRI5 versus explicitly authorized RODAS route; default derivative policy Forbidden; solve_adaptive exists; does not infer charts, certify stiffness or choose thread count
current_implementation.switchingSolver: bounded accepted-window switching, persistent RHS-only DOPRI5, optional supplied Jacobian/JVP/FD challenger, work-pressure pilots, recheck/backoff and complete-attempt accounting
current_implementation.declaredStructureRouting: caller-declared and validated RODAS backend routing; not automatic portfolio inference
current_implementation.Lawson: declared damped-rotation structure selected by caller; automatic structural discovery/competition not implemented
current_implementation.C8: R2/R4 COMPLETE_SCOPED; C8 numerical validation PENDING
current_implementation.PR98: scoped guarded symbolic controller-state/ownership proof; not physical ODE Markov partition

negative_evidence.finding: 864 single-thread configurations; rapid oscillation JVP switching about 32.5x slower than whole DOPRI5 at common endpoint-error cap; FD also slower in that rapid case
negative_evidence.policy: never use explicit pressure/rejection alone as stiffness certificate or universal switch trigger

negative_evidence.finding: same-checkpoint bounded pilot can reject costly JVP entry, but a later stiff-transition case showed early negative evidence can miss a later regime and the probe policy about 3.05x slower
negative_evidence.policy: negative evidence expires on deterioration/relaxation/epoch and is re-probed under bounded budget; never trust initial pilot forever

claims.adaptive_selection: a policy decision over currently admitted candidates
claims.economic_benefit: requires same achieved global error and full-IVP cost
claims.switching_stability: requires actual accepted-step/history error-transfer map analysis

stop_rules: feature cannot be observed within derivative permission
candidate fails original residual or requested output/error contract
